The design would sustain the maximum forces of a full dam and the sluceways would be designed to release enough water to keep water from going over the dam in worst case (~100 or 500 year storm history). If they didn't drain the dam sufficiently prior to their rainy season and its anticipated runoff, they may not be able to control the water level with the sluceways and it could overflow. Its really all about the quality if the soil prep around the dam, the quality of the concrete, steel reinforcement, design, operation.
